impl.summary: Built exact orbits on both engines. An orbit's numbers (degrees 30-360, direction seen from above, tilt 0-20°, pulse none or 25%) become N7-5 camera-path keys. Cloud: H3 Max camera-controls with those keys (5 s at 768P = $0.40). With reference views it uses minimax-h3-max ref2v, with the path in words. Open engine: MoGe 2 depth (oss-scene-moge), then a new headless point-cloud renderer in the server (option B, no new node pack), then wan21-i2v-uni3c-path. These run through one shared planner (src/lib/catalog/fly-around.ts) and a new /api/fly-around route. That route and the planner serve the Exact switch in Fuobe DoP (360 Orbit, Arc Left, Arc Right, Lazy Orbit) and Cinema's move picker (drone-orbit, arc-left, arc-right, bullet-time), plus Image to 3D's 'Film it photoreal', Canvas's Camera path and Fly around nodes, Assist/MCP's fly_around tool, and a row on the GPU pre-flight board. No WorldCast or Regenerate route is used, and nothing goes to the cloud that isn't hosted. 3 commits, not pushed.
built: src/lib/exact-orbit.ts: ExactOrbit settings, defaults per DoP preset and Cinema move, normalizeExact, exactOrbitKeys (at most 12 keys so H3 Max takes them unchanged; the tilt is a ring tilted about the line of sight and rises first in either direction; the pulse moves in and out twice), exactSummary and exactWords.

New ChainSlot.render 'path' (types.ts). In generations.ts, pickOutput takes the scene step's depth image for it, and advanceDependents renders the path inside the step's run (asRun) after the other slots are filled. A demo depth step hands on a placeholder video.

findings.title: The server's path render runs again on every runner sweep while ComfyUI isn't answering, leaving one stored MP4 behind each time
findings.where: src/server/generations.ts advanceDependents (the new render loop, about L1334-1346, runs before the ComfyUI probe at about L1350-1364)
findings.detail: renderPathVideo is awaited, and adoptFile stores its result, before the step checks that ComfyUI is reachable. When the probe misses, the step sets a COMFY_WAIT entry and `continue`s, so the rendered values are thrown away. The next tick (POLL_MS 1500 ms) renders again: several seconds of main-thread CPU, 300k points × 81 frames plus ffmpeg, and a new derived file. This can repeat for up to COMFY_WAIT (60 s). tick() awaits advanceDependents inside Promise.all behind state.busy, so the owner's other polls also stall for those sweeps. Traced in code; this needs real ComfyUI downtime, so it was not run. Fix: do the ComfyUI wait check (or a per-row cache of the render URL) before rendering, or render only once the step is about to be submitted.

findings.title: Accounts are shown the Exact switch in Fuobe DoP (and Cinema), but their run is always refused
findings.detail: The proxy answers POST /api/fly-around with 403 own-gpu-tool for accounts (tests/public-signup-tools.test.ts confirms this). The open route also starts with a 3D model, which is closed to accounts. Even so, the composer shows the switch to every viewer, and the price preview (open to visitors through priceAs) says 'Free · on your GPU'. Clicking Generate then gives the generic own-gpu-tool toast: 'This tool isn't available here. Try the Image, Video or Audio studio…', while the account is already in the Video studio. The implementer says DoP/Cinema Exact are owner-only for now, but the UI doesn't reflect that. The composer has no visitor check (useLikelyVisitor exists and model3d-studio uses it). Hide the switch, or say plainly why it can't run, for accounts.

findings.title: Canvas Fly around with views on the cloud drops the Camera path's numbers from the words
findings.where: src/lib/catalog/canvas.ts flyAroundRequest → planFlyAround({ keys }) ; src/lib/catalog/fly-around.ts ref2v branch
findings.detail: flyAroundRequest always passes `keys`, never `orbit`. So when a Camera path set to 'Exact orbit…' (or any preset) feeds a Fly around that has views, the ref2v prompt is the generic 'The camera flies around the subject' instead of exactWords(orbit): degrees, direction, tilt and pulse are lost. findings.title: In Cinema, the Exact numbers don't follow a change of orbit move
findings.where: src/components/cinema/prompt-bar.tsx (MoveChips onChange only sets moves; draft.exact kept)
findings.detail: Turn Exact on for Drone Orbit (360°, tilt 15) and then switch the first move to Arc Left: the switch stays on with 360°/tilt 15 instead of Arc Left's 90° clockwise. The DoP composer keys its state by preset id and resets; Cinema doesn't. Reset draft.exact when moves[0] changes.

findings.title: The tilt wording says the camera 'rises and comes back level', but past 180° it also dips below eye level
findings.where: src/lib/exact-orbit.ts exactWords and the ExactOrbit.tilt doc; studio-tools fly_around tilt description
findings.detail: elevation = asin(sin tilt · sin turned), so for degrees > 180 the elevation goes negative (down to −tilt at 270°). The keys are correct; only the words sent to ref2v and Assist describe a different move.

Before merging, fix the repeated path render while waiting for ComfyUI (medium) and hide or explain the Exact switch for accounts (medium). The low items are polish.

In advanceDependents (src/server/generations.ts) the server's camera-path render now runs after the ComfyUI wait check, so a sweep that waits renders nothing and stores no MP4. New regression test in tests/comfy-reach.test.ts: a Uni3C path step after a real ComfyUI depth step stays queued at 'Waits for ComfyUI to answer'. It fails without the fix, because the old order rendered first and failed the step. Commit dd01fa16.

Visitors no longer see it, and it doesn't flash before hydration.

Low, Canvas Fly around with views lost the path's numbers: confirmed. canvas.ts now passes the Camera path node's own input (orbit, preset or keys) to planFlyAround. The new pathWords in src/lib/catalog/fly-around.ts turns an orbit, a named preset or an orbit_<N>_cw/ccw sweep into words for the H3 Max ref2v prompt. Assist's preset-with-views case is fixed by the same change. Tests added in tests/fly-around.test.ts.

Low, the phone composer squeezed the model chip: confirmed in the screenshot. flyPrice takes a compact flag and useFlyAround returns compactPrice ('Free' / 'Placeholder'). The composer's sm:hidden price uses it. Unit test added; the e2e phone assertion was updated and the dop-390-dark screenshot looked at (the model chip reads 'MiniMax H3').

Low, Cinema's Exact numbers didn't follow a change of first move: confirmed. New withMoves in src/components/cinema/draft.ts resets exact to null when moves[0] changes. It is used by MoveChips, the move picker and the AI Director's shot fill (workspace.tsx). Unit test added.

Low, tilt wording: confirmed (elevation goes negative past 180 degrees). exactWords now describes the height by sweep: rises as it goes (90 degrees or less), comes back down (up to 180), dips below (under 360), a full rise and dip back to eye level (360). The ExactOrbit.tilt doc and the fly_around tool's tilt description were corrected. Tests check the words against the keys.
